evidence: Tagged with Descriptors label and refactors core descriptor representation across src/script/descriptor.* and wallet management files (src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp, src/wallet/wallet.cpp).
rationale: Refactors descriptor parsing so multipath descriptors are first-class single objects rather than expanded syntactic sugar, unblocking #36443 and #36444. As the description notes, multipath elements were previously 'lost as the result is the multiple distinct descriptors that the multipath is a shorthand for', preventing callers from preserving or retrieving original multipath strings. Resolving this represents a major structural improvement for descriptor wallet architecture.
